item.title: 24-year-old man convicted of murder in 2024 near 56th, Georgetown Road
item.description: Kobe Bond, 24, of Indianapolis, was convicted of murder for the July 2024 shooting death of 21-year-old Tyreana Terrell at a gas station near West 56th Street and Georgetown Road after a physical altercation between Terrell and another woman. Security footage and witness statements led to his conviction.

item.title: Trump orders US agencies to stop using Anthropic tech in clash over AI safety
item.description: The Trump administration has imposed penalties on Anthropic for refusing to allow the military unrestricted use of its artificial intelligence technology, culminating in a public clash between the government and the company over AI safety.

item.title: New bridge over 96th Street adds to Nickel Plate Trail connections
item.description: The Nickel Plate Trail pedestrian bridge over 96th Street in Fishers is now open. The crossing provides a critical connection point for the trail and includes a 1.3-mile extension. A $4.5 million grant from the Indiana Department of Natural Resources made the connection possible.

item.title: Plea deal filed in death of former HSE football star Mason Alexander
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — The 18-year-old charged in the death of former Hamilton Southeastern High School football star Mason Alexander has filed a plea agreement. Online court records show attorneys for Trey Williams filed the agreement Friday. item.title: THE ZONE: Scores and Highlights – February 27, 2026
item.description: "The Zone" featured highlights from eight high school boys basketball games from across central Indiana on Friday, including Beech Grove at Whiteland, Metropolitan at Franklin, and Purdue Poly Englewood at Lutheran.

item.title: Indiana lawmakers wrap up 2026 legislative session
item.description: Indiana lawmakers passed legislation to create a northwest Indiana stadium authority, expand eligibility for Indiana's employer-sponsored child care tax credit program, and crack down on commercial drivers without proper immigration documentation.

item.title: NFL combine brings millions of dollars to Indianapolis economy
item.description: The 2026 NFL scouting combine will bring millions of dollars to Indianapolis, with Heisman trophy winner and Indiana University quarterback Fernando Mendoza expected to be a huge draw.

item.title: Fernando Mendoza receives hero’s welcome at St. Elmo Steak House
item.description: IU quarterback Fernando Mendoza was greeted with a standing ovation at St. Elmo Steak House in Indianapolis, where he is attending the NFL Combine, after leading the Hoosiers to their first ever football national championship and winning the Heisman Trophy.

item.title: Family claims abuse in Henry County jail led to son’s death; sheriff denies
item.description: Nicholas Gulley, who had been arrested for trespassing and jailed in Henry County, Indiana, was airlifted to an Indianapolis hospital after, his mother claims, sheriff's deputies used excessive force in an altercation with him. The sheriff's denies the mother's claims. I-Team 8's Tim Spears reports.

item.title: Pedestrian dies after colliding with an IndyGo bus on North Post Road
item.description: A female pedestrian died after colliding with an IndyGo bus on North Post Road, and Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department is investigating the crash.
